name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Boyd, Art, Liam, and Debate belong to different classes.
Art goes with at least two of Frost, Quinn, and Robotics.
Between Art and Liam, one goes with Ames and the other with Carver.
Yearbook goes with either Carver or Liam (but not both).
Either Debate goes with Biology or French goes with Jonah.
Debate does not go with Piper if and only if Liam does not go with French.
Ames goes with exactly two of French, Liam, and Debate.
